clips.title: The story
paras: Across Kalimdor and Lordaeron, shaman gather what Brine needs for a draught. Its last drops wait for a perilous journey.

Brine prepares a water draught in the Barrens from water gathered across Kalimdor and Lordaeron. Part of it gives shaman vision of distant elements. The remaining drops are kept for a harder purpose. Shaman carry them to the coast of Silverpine Forest, near the Sepulcher, where the Brazier of Everfount stands. There, the drops are burned with the bracers of a fallen, tainted elemental. The pure water cuts through the undead plague’s corruption, calling an untainted water spirit to commune with the shaman and complete their communion with the element.
